title: The Trojan War and the Wooden Horse
subtitle: Greek mythology
subject: mythologie
description: Ten years of siege, gods on both sides, then a wooden horse. The greatest epic tale of ancient Greece, and the archetype of military ruse.

hero.hook: A golden apple, a kidnapped woman, then ten years of war: Troy does not fall under arms, but by a wooden horse.

blocks.text: The **Trojan War** is the great story of ancient Greece, immortalized by Homer in the Iliad. A coalition of Greek cities besieged , another name for Troy, for **ten years**. Gods take sides. Heroes die for honor. [[Ilium]]
The city does not yield to force. She falls by a stratagem: the **wooden horse**. This ruse has become a universal symbol, from the battlefield to today's computer viruses.

sections.title: A golden apple starts it all

blocks.text: It all begins at the wedding of Peleus and the nymph Thetis. **Eris**, goddess of Discord, is not invited. Furious, she throws a golden apple engraved “To the fairest”. Three goddesses claim her: **Hera**, **Athena** and **Aphrodite**.

Zeus asks the opinion of a mortal: **Paris**, prince of Troy. Hera promises him power, Athena victory in battle, Aphrodite the love of the most beautiful woman. He chooses Aphrodite. She offers him **Hélène**, wife of **Menelaus**, king of Sparta. Paris takes him to Troy. Greece stands up to get it back.
In Hisarlik, Turkey, archaeologists found a burned city around **1184 BC.**: the possible site of historical Troy, behind the myth.

sections.title: Ten years of siege without a winner

blocks.text: **Agamemnon**, brother of Menelaus and king of Mycenae, takes command. A huge fleet leaves: Achilles, Ajax, the wise Nestor, the cunning **Ulysses**. The Greeks, or Achaeans, land in , the region of Troy, and the siege begins. [[Troad]]

blocks.caption: The Greek fleet: legend speaks of a thousand ships.

blocks.text: The walls of Troy are said to be indestructible, built with the help of Poseidon and Apollo. For ten years, we fought on the plain of  without decision. On earth, people die. On Olympus, Hera and Athena help the Greeks; Aphrodite and Apollo protect the sons of , the old king of Troy. [[Scamander]] [[Priam]]

Strength is not enough. **Ulysses**, king of Ithaca and master of  (intelligent ruse), invents the trap. The Greeks burn their camp, pretend to leave and hide near the island of . On the beach, they leave a huge hollow **wooden horse**, filled with soldiers. [[Metis]] [[Tenedos]]

blocks.caption: The Trojan horse: deceptive offering, soldiers inside.

blocks.text: The Greek spy **Otherwise** convinces the Trojans that the horse is an offering for Athena. The priest **Laocoon** cries trap: we ignore him. Part of the ramparts were demolished to allow the horse to enter. At night, the Greeks came out, opened the gates, and the returning army finished off the city.
The expression “the face that launched a thousand ships”, for Helen, comes from the poet Christopher Marlowe. We even jokingly invented the “helen”, a unit of beauty equal to a thousand ships.

Troy burns. Priam is killed. The survivors become slaves. Only the prince **Aeneas** fled with his father and his gods ; later, Roman legend would make him the ancestor of Rome. The winners are not spared: their perilous returns () are often tragic. Agamemnon is murdered. Odysseus wanders for ten more years. [[Lares]] [[The return of the heroes (Nostoi)]]

blocks.text: Born from a divine quarrel over a golden apple, the Trojan War only ended after ten years: not by force, but by the cunning of Ulysses and a wooden horse which destroyed the city in one night.
